name: Kelm Hargunth
summary: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Kelm Hargunth keeps the Warsong Outriders supplied. He equips Horde champions fighting night elves in Warsong Gulch with care packages and provisions.

sections.title: Quartermaster of Mor'shan
sections.body: At Mor'shan Base Camp, Kelm Hargunth manages supplies for the Warsong Outriders. The camp stands on the northern edge of the Barrens, beside the border with Ashenvale. Scouts and raiders skirmish beyond its stockade while Kelm sees that weapons, armor, and rations reach the fighters. The Warsong Outriders face the Silverwing Sentinels, and a steady flow of provisions matters as much as fury in battle.

sections.title: Supplying the Front
sections.body: Kelm gives specialized supplies to warriors who have proven themselves in Warsong Gulch. His stores include care packages with field dressings and iron rations, along with armaments marked with the Warsong clan's crimson insignia. These supplies go to fighters serving the Horde's campaign in the forests to the north.

faq.answer: Kelm Hargunth is an orc supply officer for the Warsong Outriders. At Mor'shan Base Camp in the northern Barrens, he distributes weapons, armor, and provisions to Horde soldiers fighting in Warsong Gulch.
Kelm Hargunth is stationed at Mor'shan Base Camp, at the far northern edge of the Barrens beside the rampart divide leading into Ashenvale.

faq.q: What faction does Kelm Hargunth serve?
faq.answer: Kelm Hargunth serves the Warsong Outriders, the Horde vanguard seeking lumber and territory in southern Ashenvale against the night elves.

faq.q: What are the care packages Kelm offers?
faq.answer: Kelm Hargunth offers Basic, Standard, and Advanced Care Packages to frontline fighters. They contain battlefield sundries, bandages, and rations for Horde combatants in the gulch.

faq.q: Why is Mor'shan Base Camp so important to the Warsong?
faq.answer: Mor'shan Base Camp is a fortified staging ground and checkpoint between the Barrens and Ashenvale. It lets the Warsong clan move supplies, reinforcements, and harvested timber safely into Horde lands.

faq.q: What kind of gear does Kelm Hargunth provide?
faq.answer: Kelm Hargunth provides proven fighters with Warsong battle tabards, specialized weapons such as the Scout's Blade and Legionnaire's Sword, tailored armor sets, rings, and battlefield draughts for close-quarters skirmishing.

angles.text: As a Horde soldier, you can take up arms against the night elves in Warsong Gulch, and Kelm Hargunth provides the tools of war.
As an orc, you see Grom Hellscream's legacy in Ashenvale carried on as Hargunth keeps the Warsong clan armed and fed.
As a warrior, you rely on Hargunth's sturdy plate leggings, heavy blades, and combat rations to hold the line against the Alliance.
